title: MCP vs CLI for AI Agents: A Comparative Analysis of Tool Integration Strategies for Autonomous Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.30157v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents require interfaces to interact with external systems such as files, APIs, databases, and cloud services. Two competing paradigms have emerged: CLI (Command Line Interface), where agents execute shell commands directly, and MCP (Model Context Protocol), a structured JSON-RPC protocol providing governed, typed tool access. This paper presents a comparative analysis across 14 evaluation dimensions, supported by worked examples, security assessment against established compliance frameworks, and economic modeling. Our analysis indicates that CLI provides superior efficiency for single-user, local-only workflows, while MCP addresses requirements that CLI fundamentally cannot satisfy, including fine-grained access control, credential isolation, structured audit, and multi-tenant governance. translated_title: AI智能体的MCP与CLI对比：自主系统工具集成策略的比较分析
translated_abstract: AI智能体需要接口来与外部系统（如文件、API、数据库和云服务）进行交互。目前出现了两种相互竞争的范式：CLI（命令行接口），即智能体直接执行shell命令；以及MCP（模型上下文协议），一种提供受管控的、类型化工具访问的结构化JSON-RPC协议。本文从14个评估维度进行了比较分析，辅以实例演示、基于既定合规框架的安全评估以及经济建模。我们的分析表明，CLI在单用户、仅本地的工作流程中提供更优的效率，而MCP则满足了CLI从根本上无法满足的需求，包括细粒度访问控制、凭证隔离、结构化审计和多租户治理。我们进一步研究了渐进式披露技术如何消除MCP的历史弱点（上下文窗口开销），从而带来token效率……
tldr: 本文通过14个维度的比较分析表明，CLI在单用户本地工作流中效率更高，而MCP能够满足CLI从根本上无法实现的细粒度访问控制、凭证隔离、结构化审计和多租户治理等需求，且渐进式披露技术可消除MCP的上下文窗口开销弱点。
en_tdlr: This comparative analysis across 14 evaluation dimensions shows that CLI is more efficient for single-user local workflows, while MCP satisfies requirements CLI fundamentally cannot—fine-grained access control, credential isolation, structured auditing, and multi-tenant governance—with progressive disclosure techniques eliminating MCP's historical context window overhead weakness.
